name: Lesha Bank LLC
summary: Lesha Bank LLC, an Islamic bank, together with its subsidiaries, provides financial products and solutions to Qatar and internationally. The company operates through Alternative Investments, Private Bank, and Other segments. It provides private wealth management; fixed income money market; investment banking advisory, including mergers and acquisitions, debt advisory/debt capital markets, equity capital markets, and restructuring advisory; and real estate investments services. The company is also involved in direct investment in the venture capital business direct private equity; provision of private banking, including advisory, deposit accounts, brokerage, funds and investments, treasury forex products, plain vanilla, and financing and elite services to high net worth clients; and short term liquid investment and FX products to banking clients. In addition, it engages in arranging deals in investment and credit facilities; provision and arranging of custody services; manages and advising on investments; and operates a collective investment fund. Further, the company is involved in money market fund; financing, construction; and owning and leasing real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Qatar First Bank L.L.C (Public) and changed its name to Lesha Bank LLC in October 2022. Lesha Bank LLC was founded in 2008 and is based in Doha, Qatar.
